name: restApiLoopbackRestricted
definition: The management interface permitted-IP list names specific sources and does not include an any-source or very wide entry. A reply without the permitted-ip list is Not evaluated.
population: the management interface permitted-IP list of the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The management permitted-IP list showing at least one named entry and no any-source or very wide entry; an absent or empty list is Not evaluated.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: deviceconfig/system/permitted-ip/entry (the MGT permitted IP list) from the CLI hierarchy. PAN-OS allows any source when the list is empty, but an absent or empty permitted-ip element in a success reply is also what a role without access or a centrally managed setting returns, so it is Not evaluated, never False. Entries without a name are an unrecognised shape (Not evaluated). An IPv4 prefix shorter than /8 (IPv6 shorter than /16) counts as open; other wide unions of ranges are not detected. Interface management profiles on data-plane interfaces are not read.
